title: DMR: a repeater with both timeslots busy, then two radios in direct mode
description: DMR Tier II on 439.0125 MHz, colour code 1 (voice LC header, voice superframes with EMB + embedded LC, terminator; placeholder AMBE+2 frames with valid FEC). A repeater (300 deg, CACH, idle bursts on a free slot) carries 3100001 -> TG 1 on slot 1 and, overlapping it, 3100002 -> TG 2 on slot 2 - both radios' bearing is the repeater's. Then radio 3100011 (60 deg) on direct-mode timeslot 1 and radio 3100012 (200 deg) on timeslot 2. Expect talkers 3100001 + 3100002 at 300 deg, 3100011 at 60 deg, 3100012 at 200 deg.
